subject: Initial 50-day plan: kickoff, roles & timeline
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@heliomed.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Initial 50-day plan: kickoff, roles & timeline

Hi Sanjay —

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. Attached is a concise 50-day starter plan I put together to help us align on goals, owners, and a realistic close/onramp timeline. High level:

- Objective: Run a scoped pilot for HelioMed triage workflows (PHI-scope agreed) and validate throughput/latency in your environment.
- Success criteria: 1) Average latency under 400ms for 90th percentile on 256-token requests; 2) demonstration of reliability across your dev/staging; 3) signed PO for Dedicated capacity commit (if pilot meets criteria).
- Proposed timeline: Kickoff week of Feb 22; pilot validation window Mar 8–Apr 2; decision/review week Apr 5–9.

Please review the attached starter plan (Initial_50Day_MAP.xlsx) and the visual timeline (MAP_Timeline.pdf). Can you confirm you’ll be the HelioMed champion for this playbook and whether the proposed kickoff week works? If that week is tight, happy to shift by one week.

Proposed kickoff slots (30–45 min):
- Mon Feb 22 10:00–10:45 PT
- Tue Feb 23 13:00–13:45 PT
- Wed Feb 24 09:30–10:15 PT

If these don’t work, tell me two windows that do and I’ll send a calendar invite — Marissa (cc’d) will own onboarding logistics and Soojin will be our technical lead on the pilot.

Attachments: Initial_50Day_MAP.xlsx (xlsx), MAP_Timeline.pdf (pdf)

Thanks — looking forward to getting this rolling.

—Rachel
Rachel Kim | Account Executive
Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0126
From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@heliomed.co>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lisa Morgan <lisa.morgan@heliomed.co>
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 10:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial 50-day plan: kickoff, roles & timeline

Hi Rachel —

Thanks for the plan and the clear success criteria. I can confirm I’ll act as the internal champion. Two quick items before we lock the dates:

1) Procurement has a scheduled review on Feb 25 — we likely need procurement sign-off before we start any pilot that might touch customer data. That might push the kickoff out a week.
2) Security wants to review SOC2 evidence and a short note on data residency. Do you have a current SOC2 report and confirmation of region options?

Availability for kickoff: the week of Feb 22 is tight for me. Best windows:
- Tue Feb 23 after 3:00 PM PT
- Thu Feb 25 between 08:30–10:00 PT (but procurement meeting is the 25th, so that’s risky)

Looping in Lisa (procurement) so she sees the plan.

Appreciate you making the timeline explicit — that helps.

—Sanjay
Sanjay Patel | Head of Clinical Ops
HelioMed
sanjay.patel@heliomed.co | +1 (617) 555-3344
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@heliomed.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial 50-day plan: kickoff, roles & timeline

Hi Sanjay —

Perfect — thanks for confirming you’ll be the champion and for the procurement heads-up. Short answers: we have a current SOC2 Type II report (I’ll share with Lisa) and our hosted regions include US-West and US-East; for Private/Dedicated deployments we can align on customer-managed VPCs and KMS options. I’ll attach the SOC2 evidence link in the calendar invite.

Given procurement’s timing, shifting the kickoff to the week of Mar 1 keeps momentum and avoids a mid-review delay. Proposed slots for kickoff (30 min agenda: introductions, roles, scope, next steps):
- Tue Mar 2 10:00–10:30 PT
- Wed Mar 3 14:00–14:30 PT

If either works I’ll send an invite and include a short agenda and the SOC2 link. Marissa — can you prepare a quick onboarding checklist (access, test dataset, contact list) so we can hand this over right after kickoff?

On the attachments:
> Initial_50Day_MAP.xlsx — breakout of 50-day activities and owners
> MAP_Timeline.pdf — visual milestone calendar

Thanks — I’ll wait for Sanjay’s pick and will attach SOC2 evidence for Lisa.

—Rachel
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@heliomed.co>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 15:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial 50-day plan: kickoff, roles & timeline

Thanks — I’ll own the onboarding checklist and calendar logistics.

Next steps from my side:
- Draft onboarding checklist (access, sample dataset, contact matrix) by Mon Feb 22 EOD PT.
- Create 30-min kickoff invite for Tue Mar 2 10:00 PT (tentative) and include SOC2 link + attachments.
- Add CS engineering lead (to be confirmed) to the invite once Sanjay confirms slot.

Sanjay — if Tue Mar 2 at 10:00 PT looks good, I’ll send the invite and link the SOC2 doc.
